description: This source file implements a JWT token generator class 'JwtTokenGenerator' that creates JWT access tokens for users, including claims like user id, username, email, and role. It uses settings for secret, issuer, audience, and expiration, and leverages Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens and System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt libraries.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authenticated users using specified settings.

methods.name: GenerateToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token string along with its expiration time for a provided user.
